summary: Petition under Section 17(3) & 17(4) of the Electricity Act seeking approval for creation of security interest over the Petitioner’s assets in favour of Respondent No. 3 i.e., Catalyst Trusteeship Limited, who is acting as the Security Trustee for the purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for benefit of the lender i.e., Respondent No. 2, Power Finance Corporation Limited, and any other banks and financial institutions participating in the facility, in terms of the Security Trustee Agreement dated 19.9.2025 (including its assignees, transferees, novates) in respect of the Petitioner’s Transmission Project. New Delhi - 110021. **Petitioner** 2. The Petitioner has filed the present Petition for approval for the creation and perfection of a Security Interest in terms of Financing Document through the hypothecation /mortgage/ charge/ pledge /assignment (as applicable), over all assets including the assets listed in Clause 5.1 of the Loan Agreement, and all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of the Petitioner in favour of the Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (Respondent No. 3). Additionally, the Petitioner has requested for the approval of documents that create security as well as other documents pertaining to the facility. The Petitioner has made the following prayers: _“(a) Approve the creation of Security Interest by way of hypothecation /mortgage/ charge/ pledge/ assignment (as applicable), over all assets including the assets listed at Paragraph 14 above, and all the movable and immovable assets, Transmission Project accounts, Project Documents (including assignment of transmission licence) etc., both present and future, of Petitioner in terms of the Financing Documents, or as may be agreed between the Petitioner and the Lender from time to time, in favour of Lender / Security Trustee to secure the financial assistance availed / to be availed from the Lender and its subsequent transferees, assigns, novates and substitutes thereof and any refinancing lenders to the Project, by executing deed of hypothecation and power of attorney in relation thereto, Indenture of Mortgage, Mortgage by deposit of title deeds and such other security_ _(b) Or pass such other and further orders as may be deemed fit under the facts and circumstances of the present case.”_ 3. The Petitioner, KPS IVA, is a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013. Respondent no. 3 i.e., Catalyst Trusteeship Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Security Trustee”), who is acting as the Security Trustee for the purpose of holding the securities on behalf of and for benefit of the lender i.e., Respondent No. 2, Power Finance Corporation Limited, and any other banks and financial institutions participating in the facility (hereinafter referred to as the “Lender(s)/ PFCL/ Lender’s Agent”), in terms of the Security Trustee Agreement dated 19.9.2025. 5. The Petitioner has further submitted that the Loan Agreement was executed in relation to the Project Facility which have been agreed to be extended by the lender(s) to the Borrower on and subject to the terms and conditions set out in the Loan Agreement and the other financing documents. In terms of the Loan 6. The Petitioner has submitted that pursuant to the terms of the Loan Agreement, the secured obligations are secured by: - 7. The Petitioner has submitted that in terms of the Financing Documents, the Petitioner is required to create security, for the Project Facility in favour of a Security Trustee for the benefit of the lender. 8. The Petitioner has stated that Article 15.2.2 of the Transmission Service Agreement entered into between the Petitioner and the Central Transmission Utility of India Limited provides that the Petitioner is free to create any encumbrance over all or part of the receivables, Letter of Credit, or other assets of the project in favour of the lenders or the representative of the lenders as security for the amount 10. The Petition was called out for the hearing on 16.12.2025 after notice to the Respondents. Vide Record of Proceedings (hereinafter referred to as “RoP”) for the hearing on 16.12.2025, the Respondents were granted the opportunity to file their respective replies. 11. During the hearing, the representative for the Petitioner submitted that as the Respondents were granted an opportunity to file their replies, vide RoP dated 16.12.2025. However, no reply has been filed by the Respondents, nor did any representative appear on their behalf during the hearing on 24.2.2026, despite notice. Considering the submissions of the parties, the matter was reserved for orders. - (i) _the Lenders or the Lenders' Representative on their behalf shall have entered into the Financing Agreements and agreed in writing to the provisions of this Agreement; and_ _“17. (3) No licensee shall at any time assign his licence or transfer his utility, or any part thereof, by sale, lease, exchange or otherwise without the prior approval of the Appropriate Commission._ 21. In the event of a default by the licensee regarding debt repayment, the Commission may, upon a joint application submitted by the licensee, lender, Security Trustee, and their nominee, consider granting approval for the assignment of the licence to a nominee, contingent upon the satisfactory completion of due diligence procedures. Consequently, it is imperative to obtain explicit prior approval from the Commission for the assignment of the licence to the nominee of the Security Trustee or for the transfer of any assets to them. Finally, the Petitioner is required to submit the financial documents and statements in accordance with the directives issued by the Commission.
